name: WayriCAD Return-Path Auditor
description: Find PCB return-path discontinuities, unsupported layer transitions, plane gaps, and possible routed stubs.
description_full: A modeless, read-only geometry audit for routed signal segments. It checks signal-via proximity to configured return vias, supplied return-plane coverage, and branched copper that may form stubs. Findings are cross-selectable and exportable. Results are review aids, not electromagnetic simulation or compliance certification.
